Name: Bigger Caroline Portraits

Description:
Caroline is my favorite character in Stardew Valley. And during a playthrough of 
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16220?tab=description]Childhood Sweetheart Caroline[/url] &[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21711] Caroline Is Single[/url],

-Unzip this mod file. 
-go into this folder: "Bigger Caroline\Assets\[b]Portrait[/b]...[b] [/b][b] [/b]
-Select all and [b]Copy[/b]
-[b]Paste[/b] them in this folder: " Stardew Valley\mods\Portraiture\Portraits\[b]Seasona[/b]l..." 
-Replace file in their destination (some will be just added)
-Enjoy Bigger Caroline portraits
